arguments.sql_query:
WITH iso_desc AS (
  SELECT descendant_concept_id AS concept_id
  FROM omop.concept_ancestor
  WHERE ancestor_concept_id = 984232 -- RxNorm ingredient: isotretinoin
), iso_oral AS (
  SELECT c.concept_id
  FROM omop.concept c
  JOIN iso_desc d ON d.concept_id = c.concept_id
  WHERE c.domain_id = 'Drug'
    AND c.standard_concept = 'S'
    AND LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%oral%'
), first_iso AS (
  SELECT de.person_id, MIN(de.drug_exposure_start_date) AS index_date
  FROM omop.drug_exposure de
  JOIN iso_oral io ON io.concept_id = de.drug_concept_id
  GROUP BY de.person_id
), adolescent_starts AS (
  SELECT f.person_id, f.index_date,
         DATEDIFF(year, DATEFROMPARTS(p.year_of_birth, COALESCE(p.month_of_birth,1), COALESCE(p.day_of_birth,1)), f.index_date)
           - CASE WHEN DATEADD(year, DATEDIFF(year, DATEFROMPARTS(p.year_of_birth, COALESCE(p.month_of_birth,1), COALESCE(p.day_of_birth,1)), f.index_date), DATEFROMPARTS(p.year_of_birth, COALESCE(p.month_of_birth,1), COALESCE(p.day_of_birth,1))) > f.index_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS age_years
  FROM first_iso f
  JOIN omop.person p ON p.person_id = f.person_id
), cohort AS (
  SELECT person_id, index_date
  FROM adolescent_starts
  WHERE age_years BETWEEN 12 AND 17
), alt_90 AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT c.person_id,
         MAX(CASE WHEN m.value_as_number > 80 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_alt_gt_2x_uln,
         COUNT(*) AS alt_tests
  FROM cohort c
  JOIN omop.measurement m
    ON m.person_id = c.person_id
   AND m.measurement_date >= c.index_date
   AND m.measurement_date <= DATEADD(day, 90, c.index_date)
   AND m.measurement_concept_id IN (3006923,3027388,3005755,46235106,46236949)
   AND m.value_as_number IS NOT NULL
   AND (m.unit_concept_id IN (8645,8923) OR m.unit_concept_id IS NULL)
  GROUP BY c.person_id
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS adolescent_new_oral_isotretinoin_starts,
       SUM(CASE WHEN a.person_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS with_alt_recorded_90d,
       SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(a.has_alt_gt_2x_uln,0) = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS with_alt_gt_2x_uln_90d,
       CAST(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(a.has_alt_gt_2x_uln,0) = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) AS decimal(6,2)) AS pct_of_all_starts,
       CAST(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(a.has_alt_gt_2x_uln,0) = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN a.person_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) AS decimal(6,2)) AS pct_among_tested
FROM cohort c
LEFT JOIN alt_90 a ON a.person_id = c.person_id;

Among adolescents newly started on **oral isotretinoin**, ALT >2× ULN within 90 days was recorded in:

- **7 / 1,516 starts** = **0.46%** of all adolescent new starts
- Among those with any ALT recorded within 90 days: **7 / 720** = **0.97%**

Assumptions used:
- Adolescents = age **12–17** at first observed oral isotretinoin exposure.
- “Newly started” = first observed oral isotretinoin exposure per patient.
- ALT concepts included common LOINC alanine aminotransferase serum/plasma/blood measurements.
- The OMOP `range_high` field was not populated with positive ULNs, so I used a conventional ALT ULN of **40 U/L**, making **>2× ULN = >80 U/L**.
